title: How Art Directors ACTUALLY Build Moodboards
description:

Moodboards. Everyone talks about them, not enough people actually know how to use them properly. And honestly for a long time I was one of those people.

In this video I get into what a moodboard actually is, what it needs to do, and how my approach has completely changed since moving deeper into art direction. The difference between an internal board and a client facing one, how to actually reference rather than just collect, and why having 50 references usually means you have none.

This is how I think about it now. Working on real projects, trying to make every creative decision mean something.
